Res.Caption: Service Booked Date
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Booking Date for the service to be performed.

Res.Caption: Service Date Completed
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Completion Date for the service performed.

Res.Caption: Service Duration
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Duration of the service required.

Res.Caption: Service Location Address
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Location the Service is to be performed at.

Res.Caption: Service Contractor
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Contractor responsible for carrying out the service to be performed.

Res.Caption: Service Reference
Res.FullDescription: Enter a reference number for the service required.

Res.Caption: Service Type
Res.FullDescription: Indicate any additional services that may be required or performed.

Res.Caption: Service Count
Res.FullDescription: Indicate the number of service occurrences included in this line.

Res.Caption: Service Notes
Res.FullDescription: Enter any Service Notes applicable to the service required.

Res.Caption: Current Context
Res.FullDescription: Enter the context type applicable to the service required.

Res.Caption: Service Rate
Res.FullDescription: The Service Rate represents the One Off Rate agreed for the selected Job Service at the specified Location and autorates as a Cost when a Contractor is entered otherwise as a Revenue upon Completion Date.

Res.Caption: Measurement Basis
Res.FullDescription: The Service Rate Measurement Basis applies the Service Rate to the Job Measures when the Ad Hoc Service Charge Code is enabled.

Res.Caption: Service Loc. Address
Res.FullDescription: The address of the location where the Service occurred.
